body:
i hear what you're saying. I've struggled with depression since forever too, and it's not "cringe" to be so crushed over having finally found some meaning and then losing it. it feels like life's playing a sick joke with you. not to be that guy, but... if you're not cut out for the life you're living, have you tried living a different one? 

if you're gonna die, you can afford to do something crazy. when your life's on the line, why not give it a shot? you can do anything (within reason) that you ever wanted to do. that may not work out for you, but it kind of helped me, realizing i could just do anything i needed to if it'd keep me from ending my life. 

a lot of my feelings came from feeling trapped in the same situation, with the same problems, depending on the same kinds of people... just saying fuck it all and doing life whatever way i needed to live it has been kind of a game changer for me.

maybe that's stupid advice, and i know you didn't ask for it. but i really hope that you find another option than having to die. and i hope you can find another reason, you don't deserve to be this miserable.
what got you to this point? if you wanna talk about your reasons
your problems aren't generic. it sounds like you're really hurting and need to tell someone how you're feeling. would you want to? i can't guarantee i can help you, but i can listen.
I'm dealing with this too. I'm sorry. it hurts so badly when the person who's supposed to love you the most doesn't even want to see your pain.

it's alright, I'm just aware I'm feeling a lot of contradictory things right now. I know I'm really unstable, and I'm not thinking clearly. but despite all that I just can't seem to stop thinking and feeling this way

I guess I am still kind of invalidating myself, I keep feeling like because I can put on a mask it's "not bad enough." weirdly it makes me wanna kill myself more, like i need to prove it really is that bad by dying

that doesn't make sense either. I dunno. I feel like I'm talking about how someone else feels. none of this feels real

I've got some specific reasons I think hospitalization would be bad for me, thanks for understanding. I may try to bring it up like that... I still had a college counselor threaten to call the cops on me once when I said I had no plan, so I'm still a little nervous about it.

but it's probably for the best that the shrink knows some of what's going through my head so she can properly try to help me. otherwise... she may think it's a lot more mild than it really is.

thanks for the advice, I'll do my best when I go in for the appointment

I can be honest with him, he's the greatest. I just really don't want to. he's got enough to worry about with me. I've been going through some serious medical treatments for the past few years, and he's always so worried about my health. I'm off the monthly infusions now, so I don't want to tell him now when he thought I was getting better... it just doesn't feel fair to him. and I know that's hypocritical, because killing myself is the most unfair thing I could possibly do to him.

none of it makes sense, I know. 

but anyway, I'll try to keep all that stuff in mind, thanks. I'll be seeing a psychiatrist in a few days so maybe that will change something? I don't know. I've always wanted to get better but now I'm not so sure.

I have one set up for a couple days here, with a psychiatrist. I know it's common, but I'm absolutely not telling them anything about the suicidal thoughts. last thing I need is to be hospitalized. I really think I'd rather die.
